3.name: Frenzy (Path of the Berserker)
3.description: While Raging, hitting with a Strength-based attack while using Reckless Attack deals extra damage on your first hit each turn.

6.name: Mindless Rage (Path of the Berserker)
6.description: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active, and entering a Rage ends those conditions on you.

10.name: Retaliation (Path of the Berserker)
10.description: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet, use your Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature.

14.name: Intimidating Presence (Path of the Berserker)
14.description: As a Bonus Action, frighten creatures of your choice within a 30-foot Emanation on a failed WIS save (DC 8 + STR mod + PB) for 1 minute.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.hint: Extra d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus on your first Reckless Attack hit each turn while Raging.

3.name: Animal Speaker & Rage of the Wilds (Path of the Wild Heart)
3.description: Learn Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals, and choose Bear, Eagle, or Wolf prowess whenever you enter a Rage.

6.name: Aspect of the Wilds (Path of the Wild Heart)
6.description: Gain Owl Darkvision, Panther Climb Speed, or Salmon Swim Speed (changeable after a Long Rest).

10.name: Nature Speaker (Path of the Wild Heart)
10.description: You always have Commune with Nature prepared and can cast it as a ritual.

14.name: Power of the Wilds (Path of the Wild Heart)
14.description: Whenever you enter Rage, gain Falcon Fly Speed, Lion imposing Disadvantage on adjacent foes' attacks against allies, or Ram knocking Large or smaller targets Prone on melee hits.

3.name: Vitality of the Tree (Path of the World Tree)
3.description: Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level upon entering Rage and grant Temporary HP to nearby allies at the start of each turn.

6.name: Branches of the Tree (Path of the World Tree)
6.description: While Raging, use your Reaction to summon spectral branches that teleport a creature within 30 feet toward you and can reduce its Speed to 0.

10.name: Battering Roots (Path of the World Tree)
10.description: Your reach increases by 10 feet with Heavy or Versatile melee weapons, and you can apply Push or Topple Weapon Mastery properties on hits.

14.name: Travel Along the Tree (Path of the World Tree)
14.description: Teleport up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action upon entering Rage or at the start of your turns while Raging, optionally bringing up to six willing allies up to 500 feet once per Rage.

vitality_of_the_tree.name: Vitality of the Tree
vitality_of_the_tree.hint: At the start of each turn while Raging, grant an ally within 10 ft d6s of Temporary HP equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

3.name: Divine Fury & Warrior of the Gods (Path of the Zealot)
3.description: Deal extra Radiant or Necrotic damage on your first hit each turn while Raging, and gain a pool of d12 healing dice usable as a Bonus Action.

6.name: Fanatical Focus (Path of the Zealot)
6.description: Once per Rage, when you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

10.name: Zealous Presence (Path of the Zealot)
10.description: As a Bonus Action, grant up to 10 allies within 60 feet Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

14.name: Rage of the Gods (Path of the Zealot)
14.description: While Raging, assume a divine avatar granting Fly Speed equal to your Speed, Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage, and Reaction revivification to 1 HP for nearby allies.

divine_fury.name: Divine Fury
divine_fury.hint: First creature you hit on each of your turns while Raging takes 1d6 + half your Barbarian level extra Radiant or Necrotic damage.

warrior_of_the_gods.name: Warrior of the Gods
warrior_of_the_gods.hint: Bonus Action expends d12 dice from your divine healing pool (pool scales at L6/L12/L17).
